basic_details.short_information: Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC) Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026 Notification has been released on 24-07-2026 on the official website www.esic.gov.in. A total of 122 vacancies have been announced through the ESIC Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026 for the posts of Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, Senior Resident, and Medical Officer.

important_dates.raw: Notification Release Date: 24.07.2026 Interview for Professor, Associate Professor & Assistant Professor: 03.08.2026 (Monday) Interview for Senior Resident & Medical Officer: 05.08.2026 (Wednesday) Reporting Time: 09:00 AM to 10:00 AM (candidates reporting after 10:00 AM will be considered absent) Age Reckoning Date: 31.07.2026 | Note: The application form in the notification lists the eligibility cut-off date as 31-07-2027 in the "How to Apply" clause, while the age limit clause separately specifies 31.07.2026 as the reckoning date. Candidates are advised to verify the exact cut-off date from the official notification or by contacting ESIC MCH Bhubaneswar before the interview date.

application_fee.details: The fee must be submitted on the date of the walk-in interview. Fees once paid are non-refundable under any circumstances.

age_limit.details: Teaching Faculty (Professor/Associate Professor/Assistant Professor): Not exceeding 67 years Senior Resident (Pre/Para-clinical): Not exceeding 50 years Senior Resident (Clinical): Not exceeding 45 years Medical Officer: Not exceeding 35 years | Age relaxation is applicable as per prevailing Government of India norms. Retired or currently working Professors may also apply for eligible posts.

qualification.details: For Teaching Faculty: Qualifications must be in accordance with the latest guidelines and minimum standard requirements of the National Medical Commission (NMC/MCI), as per Gazette Notification No. CG-DL-E-05072025-264399 dated 30.06.2025. | For Medical Officers: A recognised MBBS degree qualification included in the First Schedule, Second Schedule, or Part-II of the Third Schedule (other than licentiate qualifications) of the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956. Candidates with qualifications under Part-II of the Third Schedule must also satisfy the conditions of sub-section (3) of section 13 of the same Act, and must have completed compulsory rotating internship. | All candidates must possess updated Medical Registration with the NMC or the concerned State Medical Council; candidates without updated registration must submit proof of having applied for it.

salary_details.professor: Fixed Basic Pay of Rs. 1,23,100/- (Level 13) + other allowances
salary_details.associate professor: Fixed Basic Pay of Rs. 78,800/- (Level 12) + other allowances
salary_details.assistant professor: Fixed Basic Pay of Rs. 67,700/- (Level 11) + other allowances
salary_details.senior resident: Fixed Basic Pay of Rs. 67,700/- (Level 11) + other allowances

salary_details.details: Allowances are admissible as per ESIC Headquarters norms and ESIC Headquarters Office Memorandum No. Z-11012/51/2022-MED-VI dated 08.12.2022, or any subsequent orders. Non-medical officers, if selected, are not entitled to Non-Practicing Allowance (NPA).

selection_process: Selection is based on the candidate's acquired academic credentials and performance in the interview
conducted by a duly constituted selection board. The result will be published only in the Recruitments section of the official website
www.esic.gov.in. The offer of appointment will be sent through e-mail only. Selected candidates must join as per the instructions mentioned in the offer of appointment.
how_to_apply: Offline Application Only: There is no online application process. Candidates must bring the completed offline application form (attached with the advertisement) along with self-attested copies of the required documents and checklist at the time of document verification.
Document Verification First: Only candidates whose documents are successfully verified by the Document Verification Committee will be permitted to appear before the Interview Board.

Multiple Post Applications: Candidates may apply for more than one post if they meet the eligibility criteria for each; however, a separate application form, documents, and applicable fee must be submitted for each post.

Reach the Venue on Time: Report between 09:00 AM and 10:00 AM at the Office of the Dean, ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Chandrasekharpur, Bhubaneswar, Odisha (Near Hotel Mayfair), on the applicable interview date.
important_instructions: No private practice is permitted in any capacity after joining as teaching faculty/Medical Officer at ESIC MCH Bhubaneswar. Contractual staff are not entitled to service benefits such as Provident Fund, Pension, Gratuity, Medical Allowance, Medical Benefits, Seniority, or Promotion. Hostel accommodation/quarters will be provided to the extent possible but cannot be claimed as a matter of right; if availed, no HRA will be payable. Any absence exceeding 7 days without prior approval will be treated as voluntary abandonment, leading to automatic termination and forfeiture of one month's salary. Faculty must record attendance both manually and through the Aadhaar Enabled Biometric Attendance System (AEBAS). The valid OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) Certificate must not be issued more than one year prior to the cut-off date, and must be issued by an officer not below the rank of Sub-Divisional Officer or equivalent authority. Wrong declarations or submission of false information will lead to cancellation of candidature at any stage. Mere submission of the application does not confer any right to an interview unless the candidate reports on the scheduled date and time with the required documents. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview or for submission of documents. The opportunity for interview is provisional and subject to detailed scrutiny of eligibility criteria (Ref: 376/A/ESICH/Bhubaneswar/Recruitment/2026-Admin I/4018202/2026). The Dean, ESIC MCH Bhubaneswar reserves the right to cancel or postpone the recruitment process at any stage without notice. Candidates should regularly check www.esic.gov.in for any Corrigendum/Addendum/Updates, as these will only be published on the website.

Candidates interested in medical teaching and healthcare careers can also explore more Medical Government Jobs and MBBS Government Jobs available across India.Applicants looking for opportunities in the healthcare sector may also check the latest Odisha Government Jobs and other Hospital Recruitment notifications. Candidates interested in faculty positions can browse Teaching Faculty Jobs, while those seeking residency opportunities can explore Senior Resident Jobs. Medical graduates can also find similar openings through the latest Medical Officer Jobs currently available across the country.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Bhubaneswar Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 122 posts are being filled across five categories. The category-wise (UR/EWS/OBC/SC/ST) break-up for each post is as follows:

content_sections.heading: ESIC Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Teaching Faculty (Professor/Associate Professor/Assistant Professor): Not exceeding 67 years Senior Resident (Pre/Para-clinical): Not exceeding 50 years Senior Resident (Clinical): Not exceeding 45 years Medical Officer: Not exceeding 35 years Age relaxation is applicable as per prevailing Government of India norms. Retired or currently working Professors may also apply for eligible posts.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026 Educational Qualification
content_sections.text: For Teaching Faculty: Qualifications must be in accordance with the latest guidelines and minimum standard requirements of the National Medical Commission (NMC/MCI), as per Gazette Notification No. CG-DL-E-05072025-264399 dated 30.06.2025. For Medical Officers: A recognised MBBS degree qualification included in the First Schedule, Second Schedule, or Part-II of the Third Schedule (other than licentiate qualifications) of the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956. Candidates with qualifications under Part-II of the Third Schedule must also satisfy the conditions of sub-section (3) of section 13 of the same Act, and must have completed compulsory rotating internship. All candidates must possess updated Medical Registration with the NMC or the concerned State Medical Council; candidates without updated registration must submit proof of having applied for it.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Bhubaneswar Salary Structure 2026
content_sections.text: Allowances are admissible as per ESIC Headquarters norms and ESIC Headquarters Office Memorandum No. Z-11012/51/2022-MED-VI dated 08.12.2022, or any subsequent orders. Non-medical officers, if selected, are not entitled to Non-Practicing Allowance (NPA).

content_sections.heading: Required Documents for ESIC Bhubaneswar Walk-in Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates must appear before the Document Verification Committee on the interview date and bring original documents along with self-attested photocopies of the following: Certificate of passing Class 10th (for proof of Date of Birth) All mark sheets, attempt details, and Degree Certificate of MBBS All mark sheets, attempt details, and Degree Certificate of MD/MS/DNB/Other Examination Valid EWS/OBC-NCL/SC/ST/PwBD Certificate in the format applicable for Central Government jobs, wherever applicable State/NMC Medical Registration Certificate (updated) Proof of Publication(s) Experience Certificate Recent passport-size photograph Relieving/NOC Certificate from previous/current employer, if applicable Aadhaar Card Completion Certificate of ICMR/NMC approved Basic Course in Biomedical Research, if any NMC-approved Revised Basic Course Workshop/Basic Course in Medical Education Workshop Certificate, if any If any listed document is not produced and verified by the Document Verification Committee, the candidate will not be allowed to appear for the interview.

faq.question: Q1. Is there an online application process for ESIC Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No. This is a walk-in interview recruitment. Candidates must submit the offline application form along with documents directly at the venue on the interview date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for ESIC Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no online "last date" since applications are submitted in person on the interview date. Faculty posts (Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor) will be interviewed on 03.08.2026, and Senior Resident/Medical Officer posts on 05.08.2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the total number of vacancies in ESIC Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 122 vacancies are notified across Professor (11), Associate Professor (19), Assistant Professor (30), Senior Resident (56), and Medical Officer (6) posts.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for ESIC Bhubaneswar teaching faculty posts?
faq.answer: The age limit for teaching faculty is not exceeding 67 years as on 31.07.2026, with age relaxation as per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for ESIC Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 500/- for general category candidates. SC/ST/ESIC regular employees/Female candidates/Defence Ex-Servicemen/PH candidates are exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q6. Can a candidate apply for more than one post in this recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates may apply for multiple posts if they meet the eligibility criteria for each, but a separate application, documents, and fee are required for each post applied for.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for ESIC Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based on the candidate's academic credentials and performance in a personal interview conducted by a duly constituted selection board. There is no written examination.

faq.question: Q8. Will TA/DA be provided for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. As per the notification, no TA/DA will be paid to candidates for appearing in the interview or for submitting documents.

faq.question: Q9. What is the tenure of the contract for selected candidates?
faq.answer: The initial contract is for 1 year, extendable up to a maximum of 3 years based on satisfactory performance, subject to attainment of 70 years of age for faculty (or 50 years for Senior Resident/Medical Officer), whichever is earlier.
